summary: Completed frontend testing of Dubai International Exchange visual updates. All 7 requested features tested and working. Fixed 1 minor bug (header logo not changing in light mode).
critical_code_review_comments: Fixed header logo to change between dark/light modes in Header3D.js
All new sections (GlobalSection, DevicesSection) have proper styling for both themes
Golden/amber accents properly implemented in light mode (49 elements)
CBI building visibility improved: 40% opacity in dark mode, 30% in light mode
context_for_next_testing_agent: All visual updates tested and working: 1) CBI building visible in dark mode (40% opacity), 2) CBI building visible in light mode (30% opacity) with golden gradients, 3) Light mode has amber/golden accents (49 elements), 4) GlobalSection shows 50+ countries with flags, 5) DevicesSection shows phone, laptop, tablet images, 6) Dark/Light mode toggle works correctly, 7) Logo displays correctly in both modes (fixed header logo).

cbi_building_dark_mode.details: CBI building visible with opacity 0.4 in dark mode

cbi_building_light_mode.details: CBI building visible with opacity 0.3 in light mode with golden gradients

light_mode_golden_accents.details: 49 amber/yellow/gold elements found in light mode

global_section.details: GlobalSection shows 50+ countries, 12 country flags (UAE, Saudi Arabia, Turkey, Jordan, Egypt, Lebanon, Kuwait, Qatar, Bahrain, Iran, India, Pakistan), features (Globe, Zap, Shield, Clock icons)

devices_section.details: DevicesSection shows phone, laptop, tablet images with device feature icons (Smartphone, Tablet, Monitor)

dark_light_mode_toggle.details: Theme toggle works correctly across all sections

logo_display.details: Hero logo and header logo both change correctly between dark (white) and light (black with sepia filter) modes

bug_fixed.issue: Header logo was hardcoded to use logoWhite regardless of theme
bug_fixed.fix: Changed to use isDark ? ASSETS.logoWhite : ASSETS.logoBlack with sepia filter for light mode
